verdict.rationale: Paperspace is GPU cloud infrastructure (VMs, notebooks, deployments, workflows), not an agent or AI assistant that consumes tools, so acting as an MCP client is outside its product role. Nothing in the evidence shows a built-in agent or assistant that could connect to MCP servers, so the axis does not flip to applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
